result.summary: The image shows a high-density urban intersection with wide sidewalks, marked crosswalks, and signalized control. While pedestrian infrastructure is present, the wide crossing distance and multiple lanes of traffic create exposure risks for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center intersection crossing from left to right

hazards.name: Turning Vehicle Conflict
hazards.description: The wide intersection geometry allows for higher-speed vehicle turns that may conflict with pedestrians in the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulbout)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle green light.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the wide roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in two stages.
